Description

The good news was that he had transmigrated into a character from the game he had just perfectly cleared. The bad news was that he had actually transmigrated into a passerby character!

Blake Percival was the eldest son of an unremarkable baronial family. At the same time, he was also an unremarkable thug who had always been walking down the path of courting death.

First, the Male Protagonist caused his family to fall into decline. In the end, he was even personally sent into the Cremation Furnace by the Female Villain.

Blake looked at the Female Villain being sold as a s*ave and fell into deep thought.

This woman is far too terrifying!

I absolutely cannot buy her! I have to stay far, far away from her!

I must survive!
